metadata.system: Seal-slot crafting — the "Sealed in X" unique enchantments
metadata.note: Verbatim wiki evidence for the seal-slot mechanics, sourced from ddowiki.com via Claude-in-Chrome (plain fetch returns empty for ddowiki). Provenance for data/seed/seal.json; the Undeath pool below regenerates that seed's Undeath options. Amber is deliberately excluded — it is Ravenloft quest content, not a stat-choice seal.

seal_enchantments.name: Sealed in Undeath
seal_enchantments.effect: This item seethes with a sealed power. It can have its power unsealed at the Ritual Table, adding one effect. Attempting to add another will remove the original.

seal_enchantments.name: Sealed in Fire
seal_enchantments.effect: This weapon burns with a sealed power. It can have its power unsealed at the Ritual Table, adding one effect. Attempting to add another will remove the original.

seal_enchantments.name: Sealed in Gloom
seal_enchantments.effect: This item's true nature is hard to determine through all this gloom. It can have its power unsealed at the Augmentation Altar, adding one effect. Attempting to add another will remove the original.

seal_enchantments.name: Sealed in Mist
seal_enchantments.effect: This weapon has its true power obscured by mist. It can have its power unsealed at the Augmentation Altar, adding one effect. Attempting to add another will remove the original.

excluded.name: Sealed in Amber
excluded.reason: Ravenloft "The Vampire Hunters" quest content, not a stat-choice seal in this family.

ritual_table_undeath_pool.section: Sealed in Undeath clothing / jewelry upgrades
ritual_table_undeath_pool.options: one of {Strength, Constitution, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma} at +15 (Enhancement), +7 (Insightful), or +3 (Quality)
ritual_table_undeath_pool.bonus_type_derivation: the {{Stat|X|15}} template renders untyped (Enhancement default); |Insightful and |Quality render those types — verified against src.affix_parser.parse_line

host_cross_check.host_quest: Threats Old and New (Undying Age "Reflections" raid gear)
host_cross_check.note: Host set sourced from the ddowiki-derived gear-planner dataset; the 9 Undeath hosts are the Threats Old and New raid jewelry/clothing. A full independent wiki roster cross-check is a follow-up; no delta observed against the gear-planner.
